errors.text: The proposed W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf refractory alloy does not reconstruct the nominally equimolar Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Ti system or its target FCC/BCC phase constitution.
The cited 40-hour milling evidence concerns NbMoTaWVTi and reports TiO precipitation after SPS, so it does not establish a precipitate-free dual-BCC bulk W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf alloy.

The falsification experiment verifies grain size, phases, and strength but does not distinguish Hall-Petch strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening because it lacks specimens with independently varied grain size at fixed composition and phase fractions.

The claim that low VEC prevents brittle intermetallic formation is too strong; VEC mainly predicts broad FCC/BCC tendencies and is not sufficient to establish phase stability or suppress intermetallics.
